description: This file declares the ProxyConfigServiceWin class, which implements system proxy configuration retrieval on Windows using registry monitoring and WinHttp functions. It is part of the network proxy resolution subsystem.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Implements proxy configuration retrieval and change detection on Windows, using registry keys and WinHttp functions.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy config service with network traffic annotation.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to be notified of proxy config changes.

methods.name: OnNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change events to update proxy settings.

methods.name: StartWatchingRegistryForChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring registry keys for proxy setting changes.

methods.name: AddKeyToWatchList
methods.description: Adds a registry key to the watch list.

methods.name: OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Called when a watched registry key changes.

methods.name: GetCurrentProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current proxy configuration using WinHttp.

methods.name: SetFromIEConfig
methods.description: Sets proxy config based on IE proxy settings.
